<job index="68" id="37b541e7-dfd4-405e-af1d-caf18afa65a4">
  <company>Realtor.com Careers</company>
  <job_title>Lead Product Manager, Partner Marketplace</job_title>
  <complete_job_description status="complete"><![CDATA[
<div class="content-intro"><p>Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.</p> <p>Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.</p></div><p>We're looking for a Lead Product Manager to build and scale a first-of-its-kind partner platform and data ingestion ecosystem. This is a hands-on leadership role, you'll own the strategy and get into the details, moving between executive alignment and sprint-level execution depending on what the week calls for.</p> <p>The core of the work is two-sided: building a partner-facing platform that drives real transaction volume, and engineering the backend infrastructure to capture, structure, and enrich high-fidelity spatial and media assets at scale. The data flowing through this platform will feed AI model training and unlock new enterprise revenue streams. You'll be the connective tissue between executive vision, engineering reality, and the legal and financial guardrails that make it all defensible.</p> <p>At this level, this role requires broad expertise across several disciplines: product, data engineering, commercial strategy, and cross-functional leadership and the independent judgment to navigate significant ambiguity. You'll be accountable for outcomes that impact the broader organization, not just your immediate team.</p> <h3><em>What you’ll do:</em></h3> <p><em>Roadmap Delivery &amp; Execution</em></p> <p>Own the product lifecycle and roadmap for our partner ecosystem and data pipeline. You'll translate business goals, specifically around data ownership and asset rights into a sequenced build plan that balances speed-to-market with long-term defensibility. That means writing crisp PRDs, running sprint planning, and staying close enough to engineering to catch problems before they become blockers. You'll apply independent judgment in determining methods and sequencing, and your decisions will have real impact on the function.</p> <p><em>API &amp; Ingestion Engineering</em></p> <p>Define the product requirements for our core ingestion channels: bulk upload APIs, automated system syncs, and batch pipelines. The goal is to replace fragmented, manual data handoffs with a clean, secure chain of custody for every asset that enters the platform. You'll also own the rights-tagging infrastructure which is the layer that determines what's legally cleared for AI training and derivative content creation downstream, including emerging computer vision pipelines for next-gen media offerings.</p> <p><em>Data Taxonomy &amp; Standardization</em></p> <p>Work with Engineering and Data Science to establish a consistent metadata taxonomy including asset classification, attribute tagging, geolocation and make sure every asset flowing in is structured and rights-cleared from the moment it arrives. This requires evaluating intangible factors and making judgment calls on taxonomy design that will shape how the entire platform scales, including how well it supports model training pipelines as our AI capabilities mature. Coverage of tagged, AI-ready assets is a core platform KPI you'll own.</p> <p><em>Algorithmic Mechanics &amp; Ecosystem Incentives</em></p> <p>Design the partner discovery and ranking logic so the platform naturally rewards higher-quality, more valuable capture formats. Think carefully about the give-get across partner horizons including what partners receive now versus what they unlock over time and make sure the mechanics actually produce the behavior you're after. This requires conceptual thinking about incentive structures and their second-order effects on ecosystem health.</p> <p><em>Commercialization &amp; Cross-Functional Operations</em></p> <p>Work closely with Legal to make sure vendor onboarding and contract terms translate directly into platform guardrails including exclusivity structures, data transfer rights, retention clauses, and succession terms all need to live somewhere in the product, not just in a filing cabinet. With Finance and Ops, help scale the payment architecture and commercial pipelines. You'll coordinate across multiple groups and regularly persuade senior, non-technical stakeholders on complex matters. As the asset library matures, support in building the infrastructure needed for enterprise licensing and potential M&amp;A..</p> <p><em>Enterprise Monetization Enablement</em></p> <p>As the data library grows, build the scaffolding to aggregate, structure, and package it for high-margin enterprise use cases for financial institutions, risk underwriting, institutional analytics, and advanced computer vision applications for next-generation media products. This role focuses on platform readiness, not sales/partnership execution. Your job is to make sure the infrastructure can support those conversations when the business is ready to have them.</p> <h3><em>What you’ll bring:</em></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; 8+ years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 5+ years in product management, with a track record delivering complex B2B/B2C marketplaces, API platforms, or enterprise data ingestion systems from early build through scale.</li> <li>Broad expertise across several related disciplines including product strategy, data engineering, commercial operations, and legal/compliance frameworks. Able to lead across these areas without needing a hand-off at every boundary.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency. You're comfortable in the weeds with data pipelines, API design, and metadata schemas.</li> <li>Proven ability to evaluate complex situations where the right answer isn't obvious, including commercial contracts, partner dynamics, and build vs.buy decisions, and exercise independent judgment to chart a course.</li> <li>A clear, persuasive communicator who can adapt their style across technical teams, legal counsel, finance leadership, and C-suite audiences often in the same week.</li> </ul> <p><em>Strongly Preferred</em></p> <ul> <li>Direct experience with machine learning workflows, computer vision, or 3D/spatial data, especially around model training pipelines or large-scale media/image processing for AI applications.</li> <li>A formal network builder. You've created lasting cross-functional working relationships, not just one-off alignments, and you're recognized internally as a subject matter expert others turn to.</li> <li>Background in prop-tech, real estate technology, digital media licensing, or two-sided marketplace infrastructure.</li> </ul> <p><em>What the First Year Looks Like</em></p> <p>These milestones reflect a trajectory, not a rigid checklist. The expectation is that someone strong moves through the role roughly like this:</p> <p><em>Early on,</em>&nbsp; you're in listening and learning mode getting deep with Engineering, Legal, and our initial partners to understand what's actually true versus what's assumed. By the end of Q1 or earlier, you've got a clear-eyed PRD, user stories, and an API schema blueprint that reflects reality, and you've synthesized early demand signals from an initial validation test to sharpen the core build plan.</p> <p><em>By mid-year,</em>&nbsp; the alpha platform is live. Initial partners are ingesting through direct pipelines rather than manual handoffs, and assets are flowing in tagged, structured, and rights-cleared. It won't be perfect, but it works and you know exactly what to fix next.</p> <p><em>Into the back half,</em>&nbsp; you're tuning the ecosystem. Ranking and incentive mechanics are live, and you can see partner behavior starting to shift toward higher-quality, higher-fidelity formats. You're iterating on what the data tells you, not just instinct, and adoption of premium capture options is measurably growing across the partner network.</p> <p><em>By end of year,</em>&nbsp; metadata mapping is largely automated and the asset library is structured enough that AI and enterprise teams can actually start using it. The platform hasmoved from a build project to a running business and the foundation is in place for downstream licensing and model training.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®</p> <p>Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we’ll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow.</p> <p>Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals.</p></div>
]]></complete_job_description>

<job index="69" id="d003a762-a751-437e-af72-d1643ddba1ae">
  <company>The Farmer&#x27;s Dog</company>
  <job_title>Director, Growth</job_title>
  <complete_job_description status="complete"><![CDATA[
<h2><strong>Who We Are</strong></h2> <p>The Farmer’s Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We’re starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly-made dog food directly to customers’ doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct-to-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future.<br><br>To date, The Farmer’s Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets.</p> <p>#LongLiveDogs</p> <h2><strong>What We Stand For and Where You’ll Come In</strong></h2> <p>We have big ambitions, our mission is to give dog lovers true peace of mind by helping them do the best for their dogs – this will require us to completely reimagine how we care for our dogs and drive meaningful shifts in an industry that is desperate for change. We don’t believe this is possible by implementing “best practices” or operating how the rest of the industry operates.&nbsp;</p> <p>That’s why we’re looking for a highly innovative, strategic, and data-driven <strong>Director, Growth</strong> to build and scale channels via flywheels and to drive sustainable, long-term growth for The Farmer’s Dog. Reporting into our SVP of Acquisition, the Director of Growth role is designed to unify organic and paid search strategies to maximize visibility, drive traffic, and improve ROI. You’ll have the opportunity to take the foundation we have in place (including an existing team of high-performing operators) and evolve it to establish The Farmer’s Dog as the leading trusted pet care brand and the best option for dogs.&nbsp;</p> <p>What do we believe is important to achieve those goals? Where do we expect you to have an impact?</p> <p><strong>One Team:</strong> We don’t think of ourselves as “Acquisition Marketers”, “Engineers”, “Data Analysts”, or “Product Managers”. Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don’t think departments matter. We’d rather align ourselves to the goals we’re working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically.</p> <p><strong>We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:</strong>&nbsp; Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren’t tied to our own.&nbsp;We proactively source input.&nbsp;We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there’s a better or more impactful way to solve problems.</p> <p><strong>We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:</strong>&nbsp; We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is.&nbsp; We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long-term retention.&nbsp; We answer questions and address problems early and proactively.&nbsp; We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically.</p> <p><strong>We Execute For Impact:</strong> We don’t subscribe to “best practices” or “industry KPIs”. We’re uninterested in how we compare to “benchmarks”; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don’t subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper-focused on improving customer retention and experience.</p> <p><strong>We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption</strong>: We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, “what’s the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?”. We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don’t expect to be perfect the first time.</p> <h2><strong>How You'll Make An Impact</strong>&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Leadership:</strong> Defining the overall vision for both organic (SEO) and paid (SEM/PPC) search to deliver on customer acquisition objectives. Set clear expectations through OKRs, provide direct and empathetic feedback, and continuously redefine what best-in-class looks like.</li> <li><strong>Integrated Search Management: </strong>Overseeing both channels to ensure a cohesive approach, such as using high-performing SEM keywords to inform SEO content strategies.</li> <li><strong>Defensive Search: </strong>Own our core narrative around fresh dog food, nutrition, and differentiation across search engines, treating trust, education, and credibility as<strong> </strong>inputs to customer acquisition performance.</li> <li><strong>AI Adaptation</strong>: Staying ahead of search engine algorithm updates and AI-driven search changes to maintain a competitive advantage, including AI-driven discovery, LLMs, and AI overviews in the SERP.</li> <li><strong>Performance Tracking &amp; Analytics:</strong> Monitoring key KPIs, analyzing data, and reporting on traffic, rankings, and conversions.</li> <li><strong>Team Management &amp; Development:</strong> Leading, mentoring, and scaling teams of SEO managers, specialists, and SEM experts.</li> <li><strong>Budgeting &amp; LTV Optimization:</strong> Managing substantial budgets and optimizing spend to drive LTV-positive growth.</li> <li><strong>Test &amp; Learn:</strong> Execute a rigorous test &amp; learn experimentation plan with Analytics to connect advocacy efforts to conversion rate, CAC, trials, and subscription growth.</li> <li><strong>Partnership:&nbsp;</strong>Partner with the Brand Content team to ensure authoritative, accurate, and compelling content consistently outranks negative or low-quality narratives.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We're Excited About You Because</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have 7+ years of experience in digital marketing, with deep knowledge in Paid Search, SEO, AEO and PPC/SEM.</li> <li>You’re an expert in tools like Google Ads, Google Search Ads 360, Google Analytics, Google Ads, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Search Console.</li> <li>You have a technical understanding of search algorithms, PPC bid strategies, website architecture, and HTML.</li> <li>You have demonstrated your ability to build and manage both 0 →1 and large scale growth programs for consumer businesses (especially excited about you if you have demonstrated excellent execution of 1:1 at scale).&nbsp; You’ve done this in a holistic, customer-focused manner.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>You are an exceptional people manager.&nbsp; You expect a lot, but you support your team along the way.&nbsp; You empower your reports and create cultures and ceremonies/feedback loops so that everyone can and should operate with autonomy.&nbsp; You encourage feedback and debate from your function and across all levels.&nbsp; You are passionate about developing talent.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>You are a maximizer - you continue to set the bar higher.&nbsp;</li> <li>You lead through others - you don’t need to be the one to ‘do all the things’ to have an outsized impact.</li> <li>You thrive in high pressure, high stakes environments. You have natural drive and you work hard.&nbsp; You maintain early stage startup intensity at any scale.&nbsp;</li> <li>You’re not afraid to disagree, and yet you can also comfortably admit when you were wrong.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>You are skeptical, peek around corners effectively and continuously, and you are right the first time most of the time.</li> <li>You love dogs.</li> </ul> <h2>Office Guidelines</h2> <p>We are an in-office culture, made of in-office people who thrive on the collaboration and magnetism of working in a shared space. We are seeking individuals who excel in this type of environment, where being present fosters deeper connections and engagement. We ask all team members to be in office 4 - 5 days a week to build a collaborative and invested environment to foster our unique in-person culture we are proud to have. This office policy is subject to change at company discretion.</p> <h2><strong>Our Belonging Philosophy:</strong></h2> <p>At TFD, we believe Belonging is a shared commitment to creating a workplace where every person feels respected, valued, and empowered to be themselves. When people feel a true sense of belonging, they do their best work, take smart risks, and bring forward diverse perspectives — leading to stronger decisions and deeper relationships.<br><br>We anchor this belief in a simple phrase: “Everyone’s welcome at the dog park.” No matter your background, identity, or role, there’s space for you here. There’s no one way to show up at the dog park— just shared space, mutual respect, and the freedom to be yourself. Being included is just the beginning, it’s about contributing your voice, growing through challenges, and building trust through shared goals. This philosophy guides how we lead, how we hire, how we communicate, and how we grow.<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<br>We continuously evaluate to ensure we are creating a consistent experience that cultivates belonging for all employees, from hiring and performance reviews to talent development. We also believe Belonging happens in everyday moments of connection; lunch with a new teammate, a shared laugh, or a quick story about your weekend. Our structure includes biannual employee surveys, manager training, TFD camps, and support from Humans to ensure we’re listening and learning from our Team.</p> <p>Together, these efforts reflect what Belonging means at TFD: a culture where everyone can thrive.</p> <h2><strong>A Few of Our Best Benefits</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Dog-friendly office in SoHo</li> <li>Market-competitive compensation and equity packages</li> <li>Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, and Vision</li> <li>Company supported mental health benefits</li> <li>12 week paid parental leave</li> <li>Competitive 401k plan with company match</li> <li>Flexible PTO&nbsp;</li> <li>Discounted fresh food for your pup</li> <li>Your pet interrupting video calls (and in-person meetings) is now a feature, not a bug</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity Statement</strong></h2> <p>The Farmer's Dog, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. For more information, please visit <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf">Know Your Rights</a>.</p> <h2>Reasonable Accommodations</h2> <p>TFD complies with applicable federal, state, and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities.&nbsp; If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact&nbsp;<a href="mailto:humansops@thefarmersdog.com">humansops@thefarmersdog.com</a>.</p> <h2>We're Here to Help</h2> <p>We’re happy to answer any questions you may have about the position or our hiring process - please reach out at <a href="mailto:careers@thefarmersdog.com">careers@thefarmersdog.com</a>.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>We commit to building a competitive compensation package and company environment for all individuals to thrive. <p><strong>Sr. Art Director</strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Position:</strong> Full-Time</p> <p><strong>Location: This position offers remote work from (Los Angeles/Denver).</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>OVERVIEW</strong><strong> </strong></p> <p>Movement Strategy is looking for a Senior Art Director with strong copy chops to bring social-first, compelling creative to life for a high-profile lifestyle and retail account. Reporting to a Creative Director, you’ll help shape and lead the visual direction of the work, developing elevated, platform-native creative that brings home, design, and product storytelling to life across social channels.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of retail, lifestyle, and culture, with opportunities to create across seasonal moments, tentpole campaigns, and ongoing content streams. As a Senior AD, you’ll own creative executions end-to-end, contribute meaningfully to concept development, and help raise the bar on craft, consistency, and creative quality across the account.</p> <p>You are a strong visual thinker with social agency experience and a portfolio that shows excellent craft, taste, and attention to detail. You’re comfortable concepting alongside creative partners, translating ideas into standout design and content, jumping in to support copy, and iterating quickly in a fast-moving environment. You understand how to create for social platforms, how to stay tapped into cultural trends, and how to bring energy, style, and intention to every piece of work.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>A BIT ABOUT US</strong></p> <p>Movement Strategy creates content and campaigns for the world’s most exciting brands. We win awards, make headlines, shatter engagement numbers and celebrate the journey along the way. It’s why companies like Netflix, Amazon, Spotify, and Intuit come to us again and again.</p> <p>We’re fully remote with hubs in New York, Denver, and LA, and a presence all across the US. We believe collaboration is what takes our work from good to great, and at times, even to legendary status. We champion diverse opinions and creativity in every department, and provide professional development and learning opportunities with the goal of helping you discover your best work today, and learn how to make it even better in the future.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>KEY FOCUS AREAS&nbsp;</strong></p> <h3><strong>Creative Collaboration &amp; Concepting</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead and contribute to concept development for creative briefs and social-first executions</li> <li>Partner closely with Creative Directors to shape visual approaches and challenge creative thinking</li> <li>Translate high-level concepts into clear, compelling visual systems and executions</li> <li>Provide feedback and creative guidance to designers and junior art directors</li> <li>Contribute to concept development through both visual thinking and copy support, including headlines, social hooks, and short-form messaging in partnership with copywriters<br><br></li> </ul> <h3><strong>Social-First Design &amp; Execution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and oversee a wide range of high-volume, fast-paced social deliverables across Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, and emerging platforms</li> <li>Create visual explorations, mocks, and polished assets that bring ideas to life with a premium, design-forward lens</li> <li>Collaborate with copy and motion partners to ensure cohesive, high-quality creative across executions</li> <li>Maintain strong attention to performance, scalability, and platform-native best practices</li> <li>Write or refine short-form copy as needed for social executions (headlines, captions, on-screen text), ensuring visual and verbal storytelling are tightly aligned</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Craft &amp; Creative Quality</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Set and uphold a high bar for visual craft, consistency, and attention to detail across all deliverables</li> <li>Stay tapped into design, lifestyle, and social trends to inform creative direction</li> <li>Support process improvements and workflow efficiencies in collaboration with Creative Directors and ACDs</li> <li>Ensure work aligns with Amazon brand standards while still feeling fresh and culturally relevant</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>QUALIFICATIONS&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>5–8+ years of experience in an agency or creative environment developing social-first campaigns and content</li> <li>Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator; Premiere or After Effects preferred)</li> <li>Portfolio demonstrating strong conceptual thinking, elevated design craft, and social-first execution</li> <li>Comfortable contributing light copywriting for social-first creative, including short-form messaging, headlines, and captions</li> <li>Experience working on retail, lifestyle, or product-driven brands is a strong plus</li> <li>Proven ability to lead projects, manage multiple workstreams, and collaborate cross-functionally</li> <li>Confident presenter with strong storytelling skills</li> <li>Excellent time management and comfort working in a fully remote environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>I</strong><strong>DEAL QUALITIES&nbsp; </strong>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>High energy, passionate, curious, confident, and tenacious in learning, coupled with the ability to navigate the nuances of different client teams.</li> <li>Must communicate quickly and accurately, think quickly or improvise, and present confidently.</li> <li>Should be a nimble self-starter and quickly adjust to internal and external teams in an ever-changing environment; identify opportunity with bias to action.</li> <li>You’re proactive and naturally curious about the digital and social space, constantly looking for opportunities to evolve the department and advance the work.</li> <li>You are passionate about the work you do and treat your client’s business as if it were your own.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Have a track record of success in building strong relationships, leading teams, influencing others, and navigating client culture.</li> <li>You have a diverse and inclusive perspective, valuing different viewpoints and backgrounds within the team.</li> <li>You make others’ jobs easier (no matter who they are or what they do)</li> <li>You create a positive and open environment.</li> <li>Your attention to detail is unmatched, ensuring that paid outputs meet the highest quality standards and align with client objectives.</li> <li>You know how to work smarter, not harder.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>BENEFITS &amp; PERKS</strong></p> <p>Movement Strategy’s approach to the future of work: We embrace a remote culture and empower our employees to work wherever they feel most productive. To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have a partnership with WeWork which allows our employees to have a membership to any location nationwide. We recruit in our three main states of California, Colorado, and New York.&nbsp;</p> <p>As a leader in social advertising, we rely on the creativity of our people to deliver the best work for our clients. In return, we invest in our employees by offering them a diverse suite of benefits from best-in-class carriers, with enough choice and flexibility to keep our team and their families healthy and happy today and tomorrow.</p> <ul> <li>100% employer contribution for health (base plan), vision, and dental</li> <li>401K Retirement Plan with Company Match</li> <li>Short and Long Term Disability</li> <li>Life Insurance &amp; AD&amp;D</li> <li>Paid Parental Leave</li> <li>Fully-Remote Agency</li> <li>Flexible Paid Time Off</li> <ul> <li>Take-As-You-Need Paid Time Off</li> <li>Take-As-You-Need Paid Mental Health Days</li> <li>10 days minimum required off per year</li> </ul> <li>(11) Company Paid Holidays</li> <li>(3) Summer Fridays- Fully Off</li> <li>Week-Long Winter Agency Closure</li> <li>Support for continued education</li> <li>New Business Referral Bonus</li> <li>Movement Journey Program -&nbsp; Stipend for personal growth</li> <li>Health and Wellness Program</li> <li>WeWork Membership&nbsp;</li> <li>Positive Impact and Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) Committees&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Resource Groups</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>SALARY &amp; COMPENSATION</strong></p> <p>In compliance with local and state law, we are disclosing the compensation for roles that will be performed in New York City, Colorado, and California. The range listed is just one component of Movement Strategy’s total compensation package for employees. &nbsp;Individual compensation varies based on location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards.&nbsp;</p> <p>A successful applicant’s actual base salary may vary based upon, but not limited to, skill sets, years of relevant experience, qualifications, and certifications or other professional licenses held. Movement Strategy prides itself on providing competitive salaries and actively works to ensure there is pay equity across the company.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pay Range</strong>: $85-115k salary per year</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Movement Strategy is an Equal Opportunity Employer</strong></p> <p>Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they check every single box. Movement Strategy is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourages those from historically and systemically marginalized communities to apply.&nbsp;</p> <p>We believe that what we put out into the world matters. And since we were founded on the principles of paving our own path, we take bold steps toward what we believe is the right direction. This means addressing the big stuff: the systems of inequality that impact some of us far more than others. As culture creators, we firmly believe we have a responsibility to our colleagues, clients, communities, and the industry to live up to the Movement’s name. We confront inequities head-on as they come, knowing that this work is never done and that we must keep the momentum.</p> <p><br><br></p>

<job index="71" id="08ded6b3-57ba-4d28-b1da-56de76a0daac">
  <company>Vanta</company>
  <job_title>Senior Enablement Experience Manager</job_title>
  <complete_job_description status="complete"><![CDATA[
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 



As a Senior Enablement Experience Manager at Vanta, you will own the strategy and roadmap for our learning platform (LMS/LXP) while designing and delivering high-impact, scalable learning programs across the organization.



The People Enablement team, one of Vanta’s newest teams, aims to equip every Vantan with the skills, resources, experience and support needed to do their best work. We drive growth across the team member lifecycle through targeted development, effective enablement systems, and scalable programs that strengthen performance and reinforce a culture of excellence. Our work spans onboarding, leadership development, AI enablement, and company-wide learning tools that help Vantans succeed in a high performing environment.



This role is critical to achieving that mission by combining platform ownership with program execution. You will ensure we are maximizing the value of our learning tools while also building and scaling impactful learning programs that drive measurable business outcomes.



What you’ll do as a Senior Enablement Experience Manager at Vanta:

 - LMS/LXP Platform Management
   
   - Lead the build, management, and evolution of Vanta's learning platform (LMS/LXP), defining the strategy, roadmap, and rollout across the company
   
   - Treat the platform as a product, continuously improving the experience based on data, feedback, and business needs
   
   - Identify and launch new features, workflows, and learning experiences — including AI-powered tools — to drive adoption, usage, and impact
   
   - Act as the go-to platform expert, enabling teams to adopt it and embed learning into their day-to-day work
   
   - Partner with teams (e.g., GTM, People Ops, G&A, Engineering) to understand needs and deliver scalable platform solutions
   
   Building & Scaling Async Learning Programs
   
   - Design and deliver end-to-end learning programs, building structured, async-first journeys with targeted live moments where they add value
   
   - Build and scale programs in key areas such as onboarding, leadership development, and AI upskilling
   
   - Use AI tools to accelerate how content is created, curated, and translated into structured learning journeys with clear goals and measurable outcomes
   
   - Define success metrics and report on learning engagement and outcomes to stakeholders and business leaders
   
   - Use data and insights to improve programs, inform strategy, and prioritize highest-impact work



How to be successful in this role:

 - 4–6+ years in Learning & Development, Learning Experience Design, LMS administration, or Enablement, with ownership of programs or platforms from scoping through launch and iteration

 - Track record of standing up or evolving an LMS, LXP, or similar platform, including configuration and driving adoption across teams

 - Ability to independently lead cross-functional programs, align stakeholders, set priorities, and deliver with autonomy

 - Built async dynamic learning programs such as onboarding, leadership, or skill-based programs such as: AI using formats such as modules, videos, guides, etc.

 - Skilled at curating and translating content into structured learning journeys with clear goals and outcomes

 - Partnered with business teams to identify skill gaps and translate them into scalable learning solutions

 - Defined success metrics and used data such as platform analytics, surveys, and feedback to evaluate programs, improve outcomes, and report results to stakeholders or business leaders

 - Proven ability to drive adoption of tools or programs across teams

 - Hands-on use of AI tools to improve content creation, program design, or workflow efficiency, with good judgment on when to use them

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact

 - Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship



What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

 - Family planning benefits

 - Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

 - Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

 - 11 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
   
   

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.



#LI-remote



At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.



About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.



Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.
]]></complete_job_description>

<job index="72" id="1d264b4e-1745-4805-b4aa-aa56ce814a87">
  <company>The Farmer&#x27;s Dog</company>
  <job_title>Creative Operations Manager</job_title>
  <complete_job_description status="complete"><![CDATA[
<h2><strong>Who We Are</strong></h2> <p>The Farmer’s Dog was born from a mission to change the landscape of pet health, providing dogs and their humans with honest, smart, and simple care. We’re starting by radically improving the $90 billion pet food industry, replacing bags of highly-processed pellets with a personalized subscription service that sends complete and balanced, freshly-made dog food directly to customers’ doors. Our ultimate goal is to create innovative, delightful and personalized experiences across all aspects of pet care, and we believe our direct-to-consumer business model, holistic approach to growth, and dynamic culture uniquely position us to shepherd this backwards industry into the future.<br><br>To date, The Farmer’s Dog has delivered over 1 billion meals nationwide and raised over $150M in funding to help us build a company as healthy as the dogs who are eating those meals. Join us as we continue to develop ways of bringing peace of mind to customers, health to their companions, and much-needed change to the way people feed and care for their pets.</p> <p>#LongLiveDogs</p> <h2><strong>What We Stand For and Where You’ll Come In</strong></h2> <p>The Creative Operations Manager will play a crucial role in setting The Farmer's Dog creative group up for success and ensuring our brand is seamlessly brought to life across all channels and touchpoints. In this role, you will be an integral part of our creative development process in our Brand group -- ensuring all of our work is produced with agility, quality, and in accordance with brand standards. Reporting into the VP, Production, you will be working alongside a best-in-class (and Emmy-nominated!) in-house creative group. The work you help create will help grow our business and our brand, and will help dogs everywhere live healthier, happier lives.</p> <p><strong>One Team:</strong> We don’t think of ourselves as “Acquisition Marketers”, “Engineers”, “Data Analysts”, or “Product Managers”. Beyond denoting skill sets and areas of expertise, we don’t think departments matter. We’d rather align ourselves to the goals we’re working to achieve and make sure we have necessary subject matter expertise to drive meaningful impact. We strive to orient ourselves around customer problems TOGETHER – getting the right people, with the right context, in the right rooms/Zooms to solve problems holistically.</p> <p><strong>We are skeptical about everything and precious about nothing:</strong>&nbsp; Ideas can and should come from anywhere, and we aren’t tied to our own.&nbsp;We proactively source input.&nbsp;We talk to our customers and leads regularly and are quick to change course if we know there’s a better or more impactful way to solve problems.</p> <p><strong>We consider the customer journey in all of our decisions:</strong>&nbsp; We know that no interaction exists in a silo and therefore understand how important every single one is.&nbsp; We ensure our strategy sets prospective and new customers up for success and drives long-term retention.&nbsp; We answer questions and address problems early and proactively.&nbsp; We understand the value of different channels, initiatives, and messages and know how to articulate impact and advocate for prioritization holistically.</p> <p><strong>We Execute For Impact:</strong> We don’t subscribe to “best practices” or “industry KPIs”. We’re uninterested in how we compare to “benchmarks”; instead we orient ourselves around being the best we can possibly be. Similarly, we don’t subscribe to rigid or classical expectations of roles – i.e. acquisition is hyper-focused on improving customer retention and experience.</p> <p><strong>We Are Focused and Work Without Assumption</strong>: We are not beholden to ideas. We have goals and believe everything beyond that is a series of hypotheses to validate. To that end, we seek to work in sequence and not in parallel. We constantly ask ourselves, “what’s the most important hypothesis I should be working on right now? How do I confirm or reject that hypothesis as fast as possible?”. We rarely have timelines/deadlines and are constantly taking in new information and adjusting our priorities accordingly. We don’t expect to be perfect the first time.</p> <h2><strong>How You'll Make An Impact</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Serve as the dedicated driver for new product launches, partnering closely with New Product leads to gather requirements, define scope and build our comprehensive timelines and project plans for the Brand and Marketing teams.</li> <li>Translate complex product and launch requirements into clear project roadmaps, ensuring the Brand, Marketing and Studio teams always know what’s needed, when it’s needed and why it matters.</li> <li>Own cross-functional alignment between the New Product, Marketing and Brand teams; proactively surfacing dependencies, flagging risks and driving decisions to keep launches on track.</li> <li>Schedule, lead and facilitate project meetings including launch kick-offs, creative reviews, cross-functional check-ins and retrospectives; capturing key decisions, organizing follow-ups and distributing clear recaps so all team members have the information they need.</li> <li>Manage project timelines and resource allocations, ensuring the right people are assigned to the right work and that the objectives, milestones and completion dates are clearly communicated and up to date.</li> <li>Serve as the main point of contact between project stakeholders and the Brand and Studio teams; fielding, vetting and routing cross-functional requests to keep work moving.</li> <li>Serve as the main point of contact for external agency partners and vendors working on new product and projects.</li> <li>Optimize and maintain Brand’s project management workflows, adapting them to meet the changing demands of our projects, across brand tools (Asana, Notion, etc), with a focus on supporting new product and workstreams.</li> <li>Think outside of the box and leverage emerging technologies to innovate the way project problems get solved.</li> <li>Support the VP, Production &amp; Creative Operations in developing and refining project management tools and processes for the Brand department.</li> <li>Partner with the Studio team Producer and Creative Operations Manager to ensure all assets related to new product and launches are properly organized and archived in the digital asset database.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We're Excited About You Because</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have 4+ years in creative operations and/or project management in a creative agency, in house creative team or marketing function.&nbsp;</li> <li>You are able to balance multiple priorities and tasks with ease.</li> <li>You are comfortable adapting as project parameters expand and/or change.</li> <li>You are familiar with project management tools such as Asana and Notion. You know how to create project templates, build dashboards and seek to improve and streamline current processes.&nbsp;</li> <li>You have Google Suite and Google Calendar experience, DAM systems+ other project management tools.&nbsp;</li> <li>You are able to build strong cross-functional relationships, effectively facilitate discussions and drive consensus.&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>You're a skilled communicator and have the ability to absorb and distill complexity into simple terms to drive decision making.</li> <li>You are detail-oriented and proactive, you thrive as a self-starter and excel in managing multiple projects simultaneously.</li> <li>You are an owner, have excellent problem-solving skills and can prioritize tasks effectively.</li> <li>You are able to build strong cross-functional relationships, effectively facilitate discussions and drive consensus.</li> <li>As a bonus, you have a creative background and familiarity with design tools and systems.</li> <li>You’re a true dog person - even if you don’t have one!</li> </ul> <p><em>*Please do not include a pitch or any other work product with your application; we do not consider or use unsolicited ideas as part of creative development in our marketing.</em></p> <h2>Office Guidelines</h2> <p>We are an in-office culture, made of in-office people who thrive on the collaboration and magnetism of working in a shared space. We are seeking individuals who excel in this type of environment, where being present fosters deeper connections and engagement. We ask all team members to be in office 4 - 5 days a week to build a collaborative and invested environment to foster our unique in-person culture we are proud to have. This office policy is subject to change at company discretion.</p> <h2><strong>Our Belonging Philosophy:</strong></h2> <p>At TFD, we believe Belonging is a shared commitment to creating a workplace where every person feels respected, valued, and empowered to be themselves. When people feel a true sense of belonging, they do their best work, take smart risks, and bring forward diverse perspectives — leading to stronger decisions and deeper relationships.<br><br>We anchor this belief in a simple phrase: “Everyone’s welcome at the dog park.” No matter your background, identity, or role, there’s space for you here. There’s no one way to show up at the dog park— just shared space, mutual respect, and the freedom to be yourself. Being included is just the beginning, it’s about contributing your voice, growing through challenges, and building trust through shared goals. This philosophy guides how we lead, how we hire, how we communicate, and how we grow.<br>&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;<br>We continuously evaluate to ensure we are creating a consistent experience that cultivates belonging for all employees, from hiring and performance reviews to talent development. We also believe Belonging happens in everyday moments of connection; lunch with a new teammate, a shared laugh, or a quick story about your weekend. Our structure includes biannual employee surveys, manager training, TFD camps, and support from Humans to ensure we’re listening and learning from our Team.</p> <p>Together, these efforts reflect what Belonging means at TFD: a culture where everyone can thrive.</p> <h2><strong>A Few of Our Best Benefits</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Dog-friendly office in SoHo</li> <li>Market-competitive compensation and equity packages</li> <li>Comprehensive Healthcare, Dental, and Vision</li> <li>Company supported mental health benefits</li> <li>12 week paid parental leave</li> <li>Competitive 401k plan with company match</li> <li>Flexible PTO&nbsp;</li> <li>Discounted fresh food for your pup</li> <li>Your pet interrupting video calls (and in-person meetings) is now a feature, not a bug</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity Statement</strong></h2> <p>The Farmer's Dog, Inc. is an equal employment opportunity employer and does not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic or status. For more information, please visit <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf">Know Your Rights</a>.</p> <h2>Reasonable Accommodations</h2> <p>TFD complies with applicable federal, state, and local disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities.&nbsp; If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact&nbsp;<a href="mailto:humansops@thefarmersdog.com">humansops@thefarmersdog.com</a>.</p> <h2>We're Here to Help</h2> <p>We’re happy to answer any questions you may have about the position or our hiring process - please reach out at <a href="mailto:careers@thefarmersdog.com">careers@thefarmersdog.com</a>.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>We commit to building a competitive compensation package and company environment for all individuals to thrive. We believe in competitive base compensation rooted in location specific market data and performance along with equity ownership in the company that allows every team member to build their personal wealth as the company grows, just as much as we believe in fostering a culture that supports our team members personally, professionally, and holistically. For this role the anticipated hiring base compensation range is USD annual and the compensation offered will include a robust market competitive package of base and equity.&nbsp;In addition to your base compensation offer you will also receive equity ownership in the company. More information about the value of this equity will be shared at the time of offer. This range is representative of NYC Market Data if you are applying to this role outside of the NYC area the range may change.</p></div><div class="title">NYC Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$105,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$120,000 USD</span></div></div></div>
]]></complete_job_description>

<job index="73" id="19df3ea8-bd28-46ce-bd1f-ac502f81b387">

  <job_title>Enablement Content Manager</job_title>
  <complete_job_description status="complete"><![CDATA[
<div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As an Enablement Content Manager on GitLab's Field Enablement &amp; GTM AI team, you'll design and deliver scalable enablement programs that help customer-facing teams build confidence in GitLab's AI-powered platform story. You'll own enablement content for our AI capabilities and Duo Agent Platform (DAP), along with the program initiatives that support the field across onboarding, product education, release readiness, revenue plays, and ongoing reinforcement. The overall aim of the role is to ensure field teams can clearly explain value throughout the customer buying lifecycle.</p> <p>You'll work across Product Marketing, Product Management, Revenue Operations, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Monetization, and Field Leadership to bring new offerings, product updates, and messaging to market through clear, role-based enablement. In this individual contributor role, you'll use instructional design, strong program management, and performance insights to create learning experiences that are practical, accessible, and easy for the field to use in the flow of work. You'll do this in GitLab's all-remote, asynchronous environment, where autonomy, collaboration, and iteration are part of how we work.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li>Designing and launching role-based learning paths, certifications, and technical labs that help account executives, solutions architects, customer success managers, and partners build skill in GitLab's AI capabilities and DAP</li> <li>Building and maintaining enablement content for product launches, new offers, and monthly release readiness, including talk tracks, demo guidance, competitive positioning, and field-ready assets</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the strategy and roadmap for Field Enablement Content programs focused on GitLab's AI-powered platform story, aligned to the needs of customer-facing teams.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional enablement programs for product launches, new offerings, packaging changes, and release readiness from planning through launch, reinforcement, and ongoing updates.</li> <li>Build and maintain role-based enablement assets such as playbooks, talk tracks, pitch materials, demo flows, technical labs, and assessments that help the field communicate value clearly.</li> <li>Design blended learning experiences, including self-paced content, live virtual sessions, scenario-based learning, and hands-on practice, for field and partner audiences.</li> <li>Develop and manage accreditations, certifications, and validation programs that help teams build and demonstrate readiness across priority solution areas.</li> <li>Partner with Product Marketing, Product Management, Solutions Architecture, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Monetization, and Enablement Leads to ensure content is accurate, current, and easy to apply in customer conversations.</li> <li>Publish and organize content in Google Drive and using AI tools so that materials are discoverable, structured, and aligned to role-based learning paths and business priorities.</li> <li>Measure program effectiveness through engagement, completion, assessment, and field feedback data, and continuously improve content governance, review cycles, and program quality over time.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Demonstrated experience in sales enablement, technical enablement, learning and development, product marketing, solutions architecture, or a related role supporting B2B enterprise software go-to-market teams.</li> <li>Experience creating and delivering enablement for customer-facing audiences such as account executives, solutions architects, customer success managers, or partners, including content that supports real customer conversations.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevSecOps and AI concepts, with the ability to turn technical topics into clear, value-based messaging for field teams.</li> <li>Strong instructional design skills and experience building scalable learning programs using adult learning principles and structured methods such as ADDIE, SAM, or similar approaches.</li> <li>Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders, timelines, and dependencies while maintaining a high bar for quality and clarity.</li> <li>Experience creating a range of enablement materials such as e-learning modules, presentations, guides, demos, labs, assessments, and reinforcement content.</li> <li>Comfort using content management, enablement and learning platforms, along with common collaboration and content creation tools.</li> <li>A data-informed mindset, strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work as a self-directed manager of one in an all-remote, asynchronous, values-driven environment.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Our <strong>Field Enablement &amp; GTM AI </strong>team helps GitLab's revenue organization build the knowledge, skills, and behaviors needed to support customer outcomes and revenue growth. We create scalable programs, content, and processes that help our field and partner teams stay ready for product launches, new offers, evolving messaging, and ongoing skills development across the customer journey.</p> <p>You'll join our team and work closely with stakeholders across the business to connect product change with field readiness. We focus on making enablement practical, measurable, and easy to use, with an emphasis on role-based learning, clear content governance, and repeatable frameworks that can scale globally. We're a collaborative, fully remote team that values transparency, iteration, and shared ownership as we build programs that help GitLab teams tell a stronger, more consistent story in the market.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a>&nbsp;</li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&amp;text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a>&nbsp;</li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the&nbsp;United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US.&nbsp;Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data,&nbsp;and geographic location.&nbsp;The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our <a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLBeneUS" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">benefits</a><span data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#000000;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none;font-family:'Arial';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;"> and </span><a class="waffle-rich-text-link" href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/stock-options/" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-link="https://bit.ly/GLequity" data-sheets-formula-bar-text-style="font-size:12px;color:#1155cc;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:underline;font-family:''Arial'';font-style:normal;text-decoration-skip-ink:none;">equity</a>. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$95,200</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$160,800 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. <job index="74" id="71b7c36b-ac64-42d6-8268-f2a4b3add1ea">

  <job_title>Senior Copywriter</job_title>
  <complete_job_description status="complete"><![CDATA[
<p><strong>Senior Copywriter</strong> – Orlando, FL (Maitland, FL)</p>
<p>• Hybrid Schedule: 3 days per week in office/2 days per week remote; Full time, M-F</p>
<p>• Being authorized to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment.</p>
<p>• Exempt/Salary Range: $85,000-105,000/year. Position eligible for additional incentives including bonus, 401(k) match, health and welfare benefits, amazing culture, growth opportunity and more!!</p>
<p><strong><br></strong></p><p><strong>Company Overview </strong></p><p>At FairSquare, we are committed to providing innovative financial solutions that empower our customers to achieve their goals. Our team is dedicated to excellence, integrity, and customer-centric service. We’re seeking a talented Senior Copywriter to join our dynamic Brand team and help us effectively communicate our brand’s voice and values.</p>
<p><strong><br></strong></p><p><strong>Job Summary</strong></p>
<p>As a Senior Copywriter, you’ll be a hands-on creative force, producing high-quality, high-performing copy across print and digital channels that brings our brands to life and supports our marketing and business objectives. Working closely with the Sr. Director of Brand Marketing and the broader creative team, you’ll help shape and sustain a distinct brand voice that resonates with our audiences. This is a craft-focused role for a writer who thrives on producing excellent work, raising the bar through example, and lending guidance to junior writers and freelancers without the responsibilities of direct management.</p>
<p><strong><br></strong></p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p>
<p>•<strong> Content Creation: </strong>Write and edit high-quality, high-performing, engaging content for each of the FairSquare brands, across diverse formats including direct mail, website, email, SMS, organic &amp; paid social, TV/animation/video scripts, and more. Ensure consistency in tone, style, and messaging across each brand and all channels.</p>
<p>•<strong> Audience Insight: </strong>Use data and audience insights to inform your writing and adapt techniques to meet the needs and preferences of different target audiences.</p>
<p>•<strong> Execute Creative Strategies: </strong>Partner with the Sr. Director of Brand Marketing and creative team to translate brand and campaign strategies into compelling copy. Proactively contribute ideas and concepts that address business needs, target audiences, and marketing objectives.</p>
<p>• <strong>Mentor and Elevate: </strong>Provide constructive feedback and informal guidance to junior writers and freelancers, helping raise the quality of the team’s output. Model creative excellence and a collaborative spirit.</p>
<p>• <strong>Support Brand Consistency: </strong>Apply and help evolve brand guidelines to ensure cohesive, effective communication across all written assets and platforms.</p>
<p>• <strong>Collaborate Across Teams: </strong>Work closely with Brand team members, the UX/UI team, the broader Customer Experience Division, and other departments to integrate copy into campaigns and initiatives. Communicate clearly and stay aligned on project goals and deliverables.</p>
<p>•<strong> Manage Your Workflow: </strong>Coordinate with the Project Managers and Sr. Director of Brand Marketing on priorities, timelines, and quality. Deliver projects on time and within scope.</p>
<p>•<strong> Trend &amp; Technology Analysis:</strong> Stay current on industry and SMB customer trends, AI tools and technologies, and best practices in content creation (including SEO/LLMs) and storytelling. Proactively explore and adopt new tools to keep our work fresh, relevant, and efficient.</p>
<p>•<strong> Quality Assurance: </strong>Edit and proofread your own work and, when asked, others’ — ensuring accuracy, clarity, and adherence to brand guidelines.</p>
<p>•<strong> Present: </strong>Share concepts and copy with the Sr. Director of Brand Marketing and stakeholders, clearly explaining the rationale behind creative decisions. Incorporate feedback and iterate as needed.</p>
<p><strong><br></strong></p><p><strong>Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required</strong></p>
<p>•<strong> Education:</strong> Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field.</p>
<p>• Experience: 5–8 years of professional writing experience, with a proven track record of producing highly effective, high-performing creative work across multiple projects and channels at once.</p>
<p>•<strong> Skills:</strong></p>
<p>◦ Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with knowledge of best practices across print and digital channels.</p>
<p>◦ A passion for storytelling and the ability to develop original, impactful content.</p>
<p>◦ Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.</p>
<p>◦ Strong understanding of writing principles, branding, and user experience.</p>
<p>◦ Ability to think strategically and creatively, with a focus on problem-solving.</p>
<p>◦ Proven ability to leverage AI tools within the writing workstream to create efficiency and scale, produce high-performing UX writing for web and other digital experiences while ensuring SEO/LLM effectiveness, keep pace with competitor marketing, and stay up to date on developments in the macro environment as they pertain to our customer base.</p>
<p>◦ Experience working on multiple brands simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.</p>
<p>◦ A strong working knowledge of the latest AI tools and emerging technologies, with a genuine enthusiasm for keeping pace as they evolve.</p>
<p>◦ Experience working for a small business is a plus.</p>
<p>◦ Retail or other highly competitive writing experience is a plus — work that must grab attention fast and perform with audiences who have little to no time to spare.</p>
<p>•<strong> Portfolio:</strong> A strong, comprehensive portfolio showcasing your writing across projects, brands, and channels — including the results your work drove.</p>
<p><strong><br></strong></p><p><strong>Physical Demands</strong></p>
<p>· Working in a temperature-controlled office environment</p>
<p>· Sitting at a desk for long periods of time while viewing multiple computer screen monitors</p>
<p>· Potential lifting of boxes around 5-10lbs</p>
<p><strong><br></strong></p><p><strong>Why FairSquare?</strong></p>
<p>· Positive, energetic, passionate, business casual environment with management who are committed to your success.</p>
<p>· We’re committed to fostering talent and providing opportunities for personal and professional growth.</p>
<p>· Health insurance for you and your family, matching 401K retirement plans, and education stipends.</p>
<p>· Numerous employee events throughout the year, including our annual traditions such as a Day at the Del Mar Racetrack, Holiday Party, Concerts &amp; Sporting Events and more.</p>
<p>FairSquare serves the small business community. Since 1999, we have provided more than $3 billion in funding to over 50,000 customers to support their working capital and equipment financing needs. We are one of the country's largest private providers of small business loans, having funded more than $3 billion to help small businesses grow. Our personal approach helps strengthen small business owners and we pride ourselves on being a resource they can trust. We are believers in small business owners.</p>
<p>FairSquare is an Equal Opportunity Employer.</p>
]]></complete_job_description>
